jobs.description:
De functie

Eekels | TBI is voor de locatie Emmen op zoek naar een Software Engineer Systemen. Als Software Engineer Systemen ben je technisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor verschillende (deel)projecten. Ook verricht je programmeer- en engineeringswerkzaamheden van automatiseringssystemen. In deze functie rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de Lead Engineer en/of de Projectmanager.

Wat wordt er van jou verwacht?

Technisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor verschillende (deel)projecten;
Informeren van het team waartoe je behoort, over je voortgang en de risico’s;
In staat zijn om op basis van functionele eisen en specificaties oplossingen te realiseren;
Verrichten van programmeer- en engineeringswerkzaamheden van automatiseringssystemen;
Communiceren met teamleden, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers;
Een bijdrage leveren aan het opstellen van werkbegrotingen;
Rapporteren (rechtstreeks) aan de Lead Engineer en/of de Projectmanager.

Werkomgeving

De Business Unit Systemen opereert onder de merknaam Marpower. Marpower is een leider op het gebied van vermogensomvormers en automatiseringsoplossingen voor de maritieme en de offshore markt. Binnen het cluster Power Systems worden hoogwaardige vermogenselektronica-systemen ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en geleverd voor energieopslag, aandrijvingen, DC-distributie, netomzetting en walstroomaansluitingen. Deze systemen worden volledig geautomatiseerd door het Marpower Automation platform voor onder andere vermogens- en energiebeheer.

Ervaring

Herken je jezelf in dit profiel?

Hbo-opleiding Informatica (of vergelijkbaar) en je hebt bij voorkeur 3 tot 5 jaar werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie;
Creatief en goed in oplossingen bedenken;
Kennis van industriële of logistieke automatisering;
Kennis en ervaring met de volgende technieken: C#, .Netcore, codeSys en industriële netwerken;
Communicatief vaardig en samenwerken is voor jou vanzelfsprekend;
Proactieve werkwijze en goed analytisch vermogen;
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Wat wij bieden

Bij Eekels Technology bieden we een breed scala aan aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Cao: de cao Technisch Installatiebedrijf is op jou van toepassing.
Aantrekkelijk salaris: passend bij jouw functie, kennis en ervaring.
Een ruim aantal vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen op fulltime basis (afhankelijk van jouw leeftijd wordt dit aangevuld met extra seniorendagen).
Aantrekkelijke vergoedingen en regelingen: waaronder een bovengemiddelde reis- en overurenvergoeding en thuiswerkregeling.
Winstdelingsregelin: deel mee in het succes van ons bedrijf en ook onze winst!
Collectieve pensioenregeling: via het “Pensioenfonds Metaal en Techniek”.
Stimuleren van jouw gezondheid: door onze jaarlijkse (sport)activiteitenkalender.
Fiscale voordelen: voor de aanschaf van een fiets of een fitnessabonnement.
Jouw vakmanschap: door onze leercultuur blijf jij scherp binnen jouw vakgebied en verbreed jij jouw kennis.
Actieve personeelsvereniging: het hele jaar door diverse georganiseerde (sport) activiteiten met collega’s (meestal ook voor jouw eventuele partner of kind(eren)!).
Plezierige werkomgeving: met een goede werksfeer en collega’s waar je blij van wordt.
Interessante projecten: werken aan prestigieuze, technische projecten en producten met een duurzame impact, waar je trots op kunt zijn.
Personeelskortingen: met flinke kortingen op mode, elektronica, wonen, dagjes uit, verzekeringen en meer.
Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling: alle ruimte om te groeien en verder te komen.
Bedrijfsmiddelen: goed gereedschap en (digitale) middelen zijn het halve werk. Wij zorgen voor de middelen om jou jouw functie goed uit te kunnen laten voeren.
TBI Holdings: achter onze organisatie staat een financieel sterke moedermaatschappij met daaronder een 20-tal dochtermaatschappijen.

Interesse?

Klinkt dit als jouw ideale uitdaging? Solliciteer dan nu en ontdek wat Eekels voor jou kan betekenen!

Maatschappelijke impact

Werken bij een TBI-onderneming betekent werken bij een onderneming met een grote maatschappelijke betrokkenheid. Die maatschappelijke betrokkenheid blijkt onder andere uit de TBI Klimaattrein, TBI Praktijkfonds en het TBI Studiefonds . Met het TBI Studiefonds komen jouw kinderen mogelijk in aanmerking voor een studietoelage van TBI Studiefonds (vanaf de middelbare school). Lees hier meer over onze maatschappelijke fondsen .

KNDS Deutschland Mission Electronics GmbH, a subsidiary of the KNDS Group, has been at the forefront of developing specialized IT solutions for over 40 years at its location in Konstanz. The company focuses on creating advanced, hardened IT systems tailored for the global security and defense sectors, as well as critical industrial environments. As a comprehensive provider, KNDS Deutschland Mission Electronics GmbH designs, develops, and implements complex hardware and software systems that facilitate secure information exchange and communication. Our commitment to innovation and quality has established us as a trusted partner for mission-critical applications worldwide. The company’s expertise spans the entire system lifecycle—from initial concept and requirements gathering to deployment, maintenance, and support—ensuring optimal performance and reliability in demanding operational contexts.

About The Role

We are seeking a dedicated Software Developer (m/w/d) with a focus on application development to join our dynamic team in Konstanz. In this role, you will be integral to the development of software solutions for military communication systems, rugged hardware platforms, and monitoring and testing systems. Your responsibilities will encompass designing, implementing, and documenting robust applications that meet stringent security and performance standards. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, review system architectures, and ensure seamless integration and deployment of software solutions both in-house and on-site at customer locations. This position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to innovative projects in a highly specialized field, working with cutting-edge technologies and multidisciplinary teams to deliver solutions that enhance security and operational effectiveness.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a degree in Computer Science, Technical Informatics, Communications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Proficiency in at least one programming language such as C++, C#, or Python is essential. Candidates should have a solid understanding of application development processes, including requirements analysis, system architecture review, and testing. Experience with collaboration platforms, version control systems, and integrated development environments is required. Additional expertise in user interface design, networked systems, Linux-based development, platform integration, or information security is advantageous. First professional experience in a relevant environment is preferred but not mandatory. Fluency in German, both written and spoken, is essential. The successful applicant will demonstrate a responsible, systematic approach to work, combined with creativity and strong teamwork skills.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and document application software tailored for military communication, rugged hardware platforms, or monitoring and testing systems.
Conduct requirements analysis and participate in reviews of system architectures to ensure alignment with project goals and security standards.
Integrate, test, and commission software solutions both internally and at customer sites to ensure operational readiness and compliance.
Plan development tasks, including estimating timelines and resource requirements, to support project delivery deadlines.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure the seamless integration of software components within larger system architectures.
Maintain comprehensive documentation and provide ongoing support for deployed applications, including updates and troubleshooting.

Benefits

Secure employment with a reputable and stable employer in the defense and security industry.
Competitive salary aligned with the Bavarian IG Metall collective agreement.
Additional benefits including Christmas and holiday bonuses.
Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement within the company.
Generous vacation entitlement of 30 days per year.
Conveniently located office with excellent public transportation connections and available employee parking.
Company-sponsored retirement plan to support your long-term financial security.
On-site cafeteria providing meals and refreshments.
Flexible working hours with Gleitzeit arrangements to promote work-life balance.

Equal Opportunity

KNDS Deutschland Mission Electronics GmbH is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, disability, or sexual orientation. We believe that a diverse team enhances our ability to innovate and serve our clients effectively. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds to apply and join our team in shaping the future of secure communication and defense technology.

Job Description

Scroll down the page to see all associated job requirements, and any responsibilities successful candidates can expect.

Purpose of the Role

Out client operates high volume debt recovery services supported by a technology platform built on Microsoft Azure, with SQL Server at its core and a range of API and file-based integrations connecting the Group to its clients and suppliers.

The Software Developer will work alongside the Group Technology Director, with primary responsibility for designing, building and publishing APIs, supported by ownership of the Azure infrastructure and SQL environment those APIs run on. The role suits a developer who is comfortable working independently: given an objective, you will plan your own approach, flag anything that needs sign-off, and deliver against it, with your work reviewed on completion rather than at every step. We want your view on the approach itself, not just delivery against it — if you see a better way, we want to hear it before you build, not after.

Principal Responsibilities

> Design, build and publish APIs supporting the exchange of data between the Group's systems, clients and suppliers, from initial design through to live release.

> Take ownership of the full lifecycle of each API: versioning, documentation, testing and ongoing maintenance.

> Manage and maintain the Group's Azure infrastructure supporting these APIs, including application services, databases, networking and monitoring.

> Develop and optimise SQL, including queries, stored procedures, data corrections and reporting extracts against production-scale datasets.

> Plan your own work: translate objectives into a short written approach, raise risks or dependencies early, and proceed with minimal supervision once the approach is agreed.

> Build and maintain deployment pipelines for the APIs and services you own.

> Provide technical enablement to the wider business, including supporting the Operations department's AI and process improvement function with API access and data provision.

> Monitor, investigate and resolve incidents and issues across the systems you are responsible for.

> Produce and maintain clear technical documentation for all APIs, infrastructure and solutions delivered.

> Operate at all times within the security, data protection and compliance standards expected of a regulated debt recovery business.

About Us

We are an AI startup founded in 2020, headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with an AI Lab in Milan, Italy. Our expertise spans machine learning and generative AI for financial services.

At Gemmo AI, we build custom AI solutions that combine automation with human insight. We use a modular approach: first we explore the highest-impact opportunities, then we design and deploy tailored solutions, and finally we help improve and maintain them over time.

The Role

A forward-deployed engineer works directly with the client and owns the solution end to end: from understanding the business problem, to choosing and building the right model, to shipping and running it in production. In practice, the role combines three disciplines:

Business analysis: understanding how a financial institution works, mapping its processes, and turning a vague request into a clear specification
ML engineering: building, evaluating and improving models, from classic prediction models to fine-tuned LLMs
Software engineering: building the APIs, integrations and applications that put models into real workflows, then deploying and maintaining them

Nobody arrives strong in all three. We hire people who are solid in at least one and eager to grow into the others.

What You'll Do

You'll work on AI solutions for one of the most data-rich industries in the world, in direct contact with enterprise clients. Depending on the project, you might:

Sit with client stakeholders to understand a workflow and identify where AI creates measurable value
Build prediction models and ML-based document analysis
Fine-tune LLMs to power conversational interfaces over the client's data
Extract actionable insights from large-scale datasets
Design the APIs and integrations that connect your models to the client's systems
Deploy, monitor and improve what you've built once it's live
